name: BetterSessions
description: Enhances the sessions (devices) menu. Allows you to view exact timestamps, give each session a custom name, and receive notifications about new sessions.
summary: Names for your devices in Settings → Devices, exact times, NEW badges, and a notification when a device logs in

settings.label: Background check
settings.description: Check for new sessions in the background, and display notifications when they are detected

settings.label: Check interval
settings.description: How often to check for new sessions in the background (if enabled), in minutes

settings.label: Saved sessions
settings.description: Names and seen devices, per account

notes: In Settings → Devices each device gets upstream's icon colour for its OS and a badge for its platform (Discord, Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Internet Explorer, Opera, Safari, mobile or unknown), the exact time as a tooltip on "3 hours ago", a NEW badge until you leave the page, and Rename: the name you give is shown with a *, and an empty name brings back "OS · Platform". When the plugin starts it looks for devices it hasn't seen and shows a permanent notification for each ("New session:" with OS, platform and location; clicking opens Devices). With Background check on, it looks again when Discord reports that your sessions changed, at most once per check interval, instead of upstream's timer: Qord doesn't poll.
gaps: The rename dialog has no "Reset Name" button or placeholder; clearing the field does the same.
Discord's mobile badge icon is drawn with Material Icons' phone, which Discord's matches.
